title: MIT ion plane credits obscure 1920s scientist

tellings.quote: MIT has demonstrated a plane with no moving parts, their ion plane.

plain: In 2018 MIT showed a plane with no moving parts, pushed along by electrically charged air, and the story is that this ion plane credits the work of an obscure scientist from the 1920s. Jan Lundquist says this in a documentary on Michels' show about Townsend Brown, a physicist who claimed electric fields could produce thrust, without naming a source. If true, it would mean Brown's long-dismissed ideas finally flew.
